relevance_note: Single-patient case report with a TNFAIP3 variant: 'In the TNFAIP3 gene ... the heterozygous substitution NM_006290.3:c.1084C > T was found'.
method_note: Read the whole paper and entered every value by hand into a Python builder script in my scratch directory; no table was transcribed by script. The script only swapped ordinary spaces in my spans for the paper's own thin, four-per-em and no-break spaces where the paper uses them, then checked every span verbatim, every schema field and the 20 checklist rows per person. Individuals: the proband ('patient') plus both parents, who are tested relatives (segregation negative) with clinical information (migraine; mother's gestational diabetes); parents have no variant rows. Sex of the patient is from pronouns (he/his) only. Vital status 'alive' is from follow-up statements, not an explicit statement. Age at diagnosis is not stated (genetic result November 2018, age not given); 14-year-old taken as age at report. Inconsistencies in the paper: (1) onset: Case presentation says fevers from 7 weeks and GI symptoms from the third month, but Discussion says 'since early infancy, from the age of 2 years old'; onset recorded as 7 weeks. (2) Table 2 rows are duplicated/garbled (row labels 'C / %', 'Age 10.5', 'Age 10.5'), and Table 1 has a typo ('0.431x'); only the DNT percentages, which the text interprets, were used. Table values the text does not interpret (e.g. CD19+ and CD3+ below range at age 9, HLA-DR above range at 10.5) were not recorded. Checklist judgements: GI inflammation 'observed' from histology/gut biopsy although endoscopy was otherwise normal and ultrasound/MR enterography showed no inflammation (recorded as a separate excluded row); 'no rash' and 'no arthritis' did not exclude the composite skin-lesion or arthritis/arthralgia items; negative ANA (and normal celiac serology) did not exclude 'autoantibodies (ANA/other)'; growth failure 'excluded' per the authors' statements despite IUGR and prematurity at 33 weeks; 'pronounced lymphatic hypertrophy in the terminal ileum' not counted as lymphoproliferation; 'Infections were excluded' refers to the GI biopsy work-up and was not used against recurrent infections. 'hypo echogenic bowel' recorded as printed. The protein reference NP_006281.1 is printed but has no field; only p.Gln362Ter is recorded in protein_hgvs_as_stated. In silico predictions are not functional assays, so functional_evidence_statement is 'not reported'.
